races.name: Visit oddschecker.com Conditional Jockeys' Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
TUNE IN A BOX has fallen to a handy mark and may well capitalise with a comeback run under his belt. The main danger is Bowmore, who returns with his yard among the winners and could poach an easy lead.

  1. TUNE IN A BOX (IRE)
  2. BOWMORE (IRE)
  3. QUEENIE ST CLAIR (IRE)

races.name: Oddschecker Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
COWBOY CASANOVA has shown enough to date to land a race of this nature and appeals as the one to beat. Highbourne Karisma is an interesting French recruit for her connections and appeals as next best, while Mint Approved has to be respected on his bumper form.

  1. COWBOY CASANOVA (IRE)
  2. HIGHBOURNE KARISMA (FR)
  3. MINT APPROVED (FR)

races.name: Oddschecker Mares' Handicap Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
An open-looking mares' handicap in which it could pay to side with LIMERICK LASS, who acquitted herself well in a handful of starts last season and Anthony Honeyball's 6-y-o should have more to offer now handicapping. Stablemate Queen's Theatre has a similar profile to the selection, so she could be the one to provide most resistance, with returning Dawn Run winner White Noise rounding off the shortlist.

  1. LIMERICK LASS (IRE)
  2. QUEEN'S THEATRE
  3. WHITE NOISE (IRE)

races.name: Oddschecker Free Bets Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
JAMINSKA has returned in top form and still looks on a handy mark after a 3 lb rise for her close second at Chepstow. She's preferred to Flash Man, who shaped well in a better race than this at the same meeting.

  1. JAMINSKA (FR)
  2. FLASH MAN (FR)
  3. EASTER ICON

races.name: Best Odds At Oddschecker Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Bumper winners NIMBA and Otie's Friend both made a promising start to their hurdling careers last month with the former shading the vote under the forecast conditions.

  1. NIMBA (FR)
  2. OTIE'S FRIEND (IRE)
  3. CLEMENTSHILL LAD (IRE)

races.name: Oddschecker Bet Builder Novices' Handicap Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
PORT STATION can become another winning stable debutant for the impressive James Owen team. Novelista shades Gone Country for the next-best vote, with Wings Of Ayrton the pick of the remainder.

  1. PORT STATION (IRE)
  2. NOVELISTA (IRE)
  3. GONE COUNTRY (IRE)

races.name: Bet At Oddschecker Open NH Flat Race (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
ONE FOR SNOWY made an encouraging debut under Rules when finishing well for second in a Huntingdon bumper in March and he can build on that effort to go one better. Out In De Wild is the pick for second having finished runner-up in an Irish point, ahead of Just Billy.

  1. ONE FOR SNOWY
  2. OUT IN DE WILD (IRE)
  3. JUST BILLY (IRE)

meeting_summary.going: Hurdle: soft; chase: good-good to firm in places

races.name: Blackmores Build Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Olly Murphy looks to hold the aces in this novice and, seemingly the choice of Sean Bowen, TAP TAP SHAMIE earns the vote to double his tally sporting a first-time hood. His stablemate Lirion was given a considerate introduction to hurdling back in the spring and he heads up the opposition with significant improvement on the cards. Hurdling debutants Ink Black Heart and Not Without Danger can fight out minor honours.

  1. TAP TAP SHAMIE (IRE)
  2. LIRION (FR)
  3. INK BLACK HEART

races.name: Bridge Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
KARAKA DE THAIX might have been off the track for a while but made such a good impression when winning in points (subsequently sold for ten times more than his 3-y-o sales price) that he gets the nod on Rules debut. Debrave Soldier can't be ignored given connections, with Titi Montmartre another to consider.

  1. KARAKA DE THAIX (FR)
  2. DEBRAVE SOLDIER (IRE)
  3. TITI MONTMARTRE (FR)

races.name: Dandara Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
BLUE IN THE WEST was right back to his best at the end of last season, and he gets the vote in a wide-open handicap. Getaway Theatre could have a big say for her in-form yard, while interesting stable-switcher Midweek Voices needs a close look. Colonial Empire is a lively each-way player.

  1. BLUE IN THE WEST (IRE)
  2. GETAWAY THEATRE (IRE)
  3. MIDWEEK VOICES (IRE)

races.name: Golwg Gwendraeth Novices' Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
Anthony Honeyball has enjoyed plenty of recent success and his CORNER FORWARD is fancied to build on the promise of his handicap debut here back in the spring with this step up to 2½m sure to be in his favour. Heading up the dangers is Built By Rossies, who hasn't been seen for a while but the switch to the powerful Olly Murphy yard catches the eye making just her second handicap start. Finjimk may well emerge as best of the rest.

  1. CORNER FORWARD (IRE)
  2. BUILT BY ROSSIES (IRE)
  3. FINJIMK (IRE)

races.name: Fedwen Tentage Open NH Flat Race (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Some interesting sorts coming from the pointing scene in this bumper and the Skeltons' LITTLE PATIENCE is the selection on the back of an easy win in an Irish point. Esprit Sauvage and Lancelot du Large both represent powerful yards and command plenty of respect on Rules debut.

  1. LITTLE PATIENCE (IRE)
  2. ESPRIT SAUVAGE (IRE)
  3. LANCELOT DU LARGE (FR)

races.name: RHN Travel Norton's Coin Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
GALWAY REEL looks set to make it 3-3 since joining the excellent Olly Murphy stable. The main danger could be Impatient, who won this corresponding race in 2023 and went close off this mark last season.

  1. GALWAY REEL (IRE)
  2. IMPATIENT (FR)
  3. SOLAR SYSTEM (FR)

races.name: 3A's Leisure Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
PURE CARBON developed into a much better chaser than hurdler last season, typically travelling well when recording his third success of the campaign at Stratford in April, and he can pick up where he left off with his yard back amongst the winners. He gets the vote ahead of Rula Bula, who is better judged on the promise of her chasing debut effort.

  1. PURE CARBON
  2. RULA BULA (IRE)
  3. CENTARA (IRE)

races.name: Mongey Communications Novice Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
MOYLUSSA arrives on the back of a solid Cork effort, form boosted by the winner since, and looks well treated on that evidence now back in handicap company, with Shellrunforbriggs feared most after an encouraging return from 5 months off at Galway last time and Latopix respected now switched to chasing for a yard that excels in this sphere.

  1. MOYLUSSA (IRE)
  2. SHELLRUNFORBRIGGS (IRE)
  3. LATOPIX (FR)

races.name: Cavan Developments Supporting St Marys GAA Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
THE MOURNE RAMBLER was among last season’s leading bumper performers and looks to have been found an ideal starting point over hurdles, with Whisky Lads feared most after showing marked improvement when third at Punchestown last time and bumper winners Low Kick and Caman Hill also respected.

  1. THE MOURNE RAMBLER (IRE)
  2. WHISKY LADS (IRE)
  3. LOW KICK (FR)

races.name: Overlander Fishery Lane Novice Hurdle
races.verdict:
BARTHOLOMEW was notably progressive in 3 juvenile hurdles last season, signing off with a fine second in a Punchestown Grade 1 in the spring. A recent spin on the Flat ought to have put him spot on for this and he's likely to take some stopping. That said, Willie Mullins' Love Me Tender impressed when bolting up in a race that's working out well and he's an obvious danger. Golden Handshake may emerge best of the others.

  1. BARTHOLOMEW
  2. LOVE ME TENDER (GER)
  3. GOLDEN HANDSHAKE

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
MINELLA MACHINE looked a useful prospect when off the mark in bumpers last season and this costly point recruit is taken to continue the stable’s fine recent record in this race, with fellow expensive pointing purchase Coq Noir feared most now hurdling and likely to leave his sole bumper effort well behind, while unbeaten bumper performer Adaboy Mushy must also enter calculations.

  1. MINELLA MACHINE (IRE)
  2. COQ NOIR (FR)
  3. ADABOY MUSHY (IRE)

races.name: Tote Guarantee, Never Beaten By SP Brown Lad Handicap Hurdle (Listed)
races.verdict:
A typically wide-open renewal. The vote goes to BALLYBAWN BELTER, who reverts to hurdling on a handy mark following her recent Flat success. Brosna Queen, Le Moulin Rouge, Carrigg Island and Avondale head an extensive list of dangers.

  1. BALLYBAWN BELTER (IRE)
  2. BROSNA QUEEN (IRE)
  3. LE MOULIN ROUGE (FR)

races.name: Barberstown Castle Chase (Grade 3)
races.verdict:
KOPEK DES BORDES clearly has a hole or 2 in his jumping but his ability and potential remain under no doubt and this looks an excellent opportunity for him to get back on track. Irish Panther is a clear second choice.

  1. KOPEK DES BORDES (FR)
  2. IRISH PANTHER
  3. BOWENSONFIRE (FR)

races.name: Into Kildare Beginners Chase
races.verdict:
ANZADAM is likely to have too much for fellow chasing debutants Eachtotheirown and Koktail Brut. Arcadian Emperor has experience on his side and may prove best of the rest.

  1. ANZADAM (FR)
  2. EACHTOTHEIROWN (IRE)
  3. KOKTAIL BRUT (FR)

races.name: Bet With Tote On Racing & Sports Irish EBF Mares (Pro/Am) Flat Race
races.verdict:
Following her wide-margin point win, BALLYDONAGH GIRL was a six-figure purchase for her respected connections and she is fancied to make a successful start to her Rules career. Of those with bumper experience, Finnellatimes showed promise at Punchestown last month and could be the main danger, ahead of newcomer Jetson Jane.

  1. BALLYDONAGH GIRL (IRE)
  2. FINNELLATIMES (IRE)
  3. JETSON JANE (IRE)
